itens.trecho: Sense8 was an epic disappointment and waste of time. I dedicated an entire weekend binge-watching every episode from season 1 to the end of season 2, and it was beyond awful. To be fair, the show did have one redeeming quality - the concept of the 'clusters' and the extraordinary 'Homo Sensorium' individuals fighting against BPO.

This review is for the series overall. An exceptional series from the Wachowskis as long as you're not homophobic. 1. The writing is on point most of the time. Main characters and supporting characters shine. 2. The cast is fantastic. 3. The multiple shooting locations around the world was a boon to this series. 4. Bug is best buddy.
